news.headline: Zeon Chriss-Gremillion will start at quarterback
news.summary: Coach Will Hall picked Chriss-Gremillion to start Tulane's opener at Duke on September 5. He has started 13 college games, first at Louisiana and then at Houston.

news.headline: Two quarterbacks lead the way in last scrimmage
news.summary: Kadin Semonza and Zeon Chriss-Gremillion took most of the first-team snaps in Tulane's final scrimmage on Saturday at Yulman Stadium. Coach Will Hall said he will name his starting quarterback on Monday.

news.headline: Jack Tchienchou makes top defender watch list
news.summary: Tulane safety Jack Tchienchou was named to the watch list for the Bednarik Award, which goes to the best defensive player in college football. He led Tulane with 83 tackles last season.

news.headline: Aaron Philo will start at quarterback for Florida
news.summary: Coach Jon Sumrall named Philo his starting quarterback on Monday. Philo transferred in from Georgia Tech and beat out Tramell Jones Jr. for the job.

news.headline: Myles Graham makes top defender watch list
news.summary: Florida linebacker Myles Graham was named to the watch list for the Bednarik Award, given to college football's best defensive player. He led the Gators with 76 tackles last season.

news.headline: Five Gators make Senior Bowl watch list
news.summary: Kamran James, Eric Singleton Jr., Bryce Thornton, Jadan Baugh and Myles Graham were named to the Senior Bowl's preseason top 300 list. It is an early sign that pro scouts will be watching them this fall.

news.headline: Arch Manning named to Manning Award watch list
news.summary: Forty quarterbacks made the preseason list for the award, which goes to the best quarterback in college football. It is named for Arch's grandfather Archie and his uncles Peyton and Eli.

news.headline: Nobody hurt in Texas scrimmage, Goosby improving
news.summary: Coach Steve Sarkisian said Texas ran 120 plays on Saturday without a new injury. Left tackle Trevor Goosby is making good progress on his bruised knee, and lineman Laurence Seymore returns to practice Monday.

news.headline: Defense forces four turnovers in Texas scrimmage
news.summary: The Texas defense took the ball away four times in Saturday's practice game in Austin. Arch Manning threw touchdown passes to Ryan Wingo and Emmett Mosley V, and coach Steve Sarkisian said the offense has to stop giving the ball away.

news.headline: Saints trade for running back Zamir White
news.summary: The Saints got running back Zamir White from San Francisco and sent linebacker Deion Jones the other way. They needed help in the backfield with Alvin Kamara and Devin Neal both hurt.

news.headline: Saints sign kicker Daniel Carlson
news.summary: New Orleans signed kicker Daniel Carlson on Monday. He has been an All-Pro twice and made 22 of his 27 field goal tries last season.

news.headline: Rookie Christen Miller stands out in loss to Rams
news.summary: The second-round pick made three run stops on only eight run-defense snaps in his first preseason game. He was one of the few bright spots in a 34-0 loss.

news.headline: Yankees beat Blue Jays 8-3
news.summary: Ben Rice hit a two-run single in the sixth inning on Sunday to break the game open. Jazz Chisholm Jr. and Trent Grisham each hit a home run late as New York won for the sixth time in seven games.

news.headline: Ryan Weathers goes on the injured list
news.summary: The Yankees put the left-handed starter on the 15-day injured list Sunday with a strained muscle in his left forearm. Manager Aaron Boone said Weathers will not throw for two to four weeks but should pitch again this season.

news.headline: Stanton hurts calf, may miss rest of season
news.summary: Giancarlo Stanton strained his left calf while running the bases this week, just as he was finishing his comeback from a right calf injury. Manager Aaron Boone said the team is not ruling anything out, but there is not much season left.
